name: bug
description: Something doesn't work the way it should.

name: proposal
description: A feature idea waiting for a maintainer's decision. No code yet.

name: accepted
description: A maintainer accepted this. Ready for a pull request.

name: rfc
description: Proposes a change to a non-negotiable. Only a maintainer can accept it.

name: needs-triage
description: New. A maintainer hasn't looked at it yet.

name: good first issue
description: Small and well scoped, with a pointer to the code. A good first contribution.

name: help wanted
description: Maintainers would welcome help with this.

name: agent-friendly
description: Clear scope, the files named, a test to write first. Fine for an AI agent, with review.

name: device-lab
description: Needs a real phone, or device data (docs/devices.md).

name: model-path
description: Touches the model, prompt, router, skills or evals. Needs eval numbers.

name: ui
description: Changes a screen. Needs screenshots in both themes and both languages.

name: copy
description: UI text in packages/copy, in es-419 and en.

name: cage
description: The policy, approvals, taint or the audit log in packages/cage.

name: privacy
description: Touches what leaves the phone, or what could.

name: out-of-scope
description: Conflicts with the vision or a non-negotiable, like data leaving the phone.

name: duplicate
description: Already covered by another issue or pull request.
